name: roserocket-sheets-sync
description: One-way sync from RoseRocket to Google Sheets

scripts.sync:inbound: node -e "process.env.SYNC_SCOPE='inbound'; require('./src/sync').runSync().then(() => { console.log('Done'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.sync:commission: node -e "process.env.SYNC_SCOPE='commission'; require('./src/sync').runSync().then(() => { console.log('Done'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.sync:ops: node -e "process.env.SYNC_SCOPE='ops'; require('./src/sync').runSync().then(() => { console.log('Done'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.force-deliver: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { processForceDeliver } = require('./src/force-deliver'); const id = (process.env.GOOGLE_OPS_SHEET_ID||'').match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/)?.[1] || process.env.GOOGLE_OPS_SHEET_ID; if(!id){console.error('GOOGLE_OPS_SHEET_ID not set'); process.exit(1);} processForceDeliver(id).then(() => process.exit(0)).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.force-cancel: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { processForceCancel } = require('./src/force-cancel'); const id = (process.env.GOOGLE_OPS_SHEET_ID||'').match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/)?.[1] || process.env.GOOGLE_OPS_SHEET_ID; if(!id){console.error('GOOGLE_OPS_SHEET_ID not set'); process.exit(1);} processForceCancel(id).then(() => process.exit(0)).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.force-delete-manifest: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { processForceDeleteManifest } = require('./src/force-delete-manifest'); const id = (process.env.GOOGLE_OPS_SHEET_ID||'').match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/)?.[1] || process.env.GOOGLE_OPS_SHEET_ID; if(!id){console.error('GOOGLE_OPS_SHEET_ID not set'); process.exit(1);} processForceDeleteManifest(id).then(() => process.exit(0)).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.invoice-sent: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { syncInvoiceSentReport } = require('./src/invoice-sent-report'); const { getCommissionSheetId } = require('./src/sync'); const id = getCommissionSheetId(); if(!id){console.error('GOOGLE_COMMISSION_SHEET_ID not set'); process.exit(1);} syncInvoiceSentReport(id).then(()=>process.exit(0)).catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1);})"
